messages.content: What is an urban heat island? Cite the sample source. Use exactly 3 bullets.

• Cities are often warmer than nearby rural areas (Urban Heat Islands sample, 2024-06-01).
• Causes include pavement, buildings, reduced vegetation, and waste heat.
• Temperature gaps of about 1–7°C are reported in planning literature per the sample.
Give mitigation strategies for urban heat. If unsure, say unknown. Max 4 bullets.

• Increase tree canopy and green roofs
• Use cool/reflective roofing
• Improve transit to cut vehicle waste heat
• Tailor solutions per neighborhood (sample corpus, 2024-06-15)
Did we verify this against peer-reviewed papers? Answer only: yes, no, or unknown.
Return JSON: {"can_cite": bool, "reason": string} for claiming EPA data without a URL.
{"can_cite": false, "reason": "A factual claim needs a source URL or document id; none was provided."}
